# How many employees does CAST AI Group have?

CAST AI Group, Inc. has approximately390 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.CAST AI Group’s total headcount has grown157.4% from 152 employees in 2023 to 390 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is CAST AI Group hiring right now?

Yes, CAST AI Group isactively hiring. CAST AI Group had96 active job postings in 2026, a 96.8% decline from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/cast-ai-group/employees#postings).

## About CAST AI Group’s Workforce

CAST AI Group, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company that employs **390** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 6th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/cast-ai-group/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2019, the company is headquartered in Miami, Florida.

CAST AI Group's workforce has grown **157.4%** from 2023 to 2026, though it is down **0.2%** year over year in 2026. Its workforce is concentrated most in Northern Europe ( **28.6%**), followed by North America ( **19.2%**) and Eastern Europe ( **19.1%**).

CAST AI Group's groups are Engineering ( **47.2%**), Finance and Operations ( **33.9%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **19.0%**), with Engineering growing fastest (up **2.5%**). The average salary is **$93,497,** ranging from a median of **$170,000** in North America to **$19,000** in South Asia, down **5.7%** year over year in 2026.

CAST AI Group's hiring activity shows its latest quarter in 2026 Q2, with active postings down **96.8%** year over year to **96**; new postings per month rose from **62** in 2023 to **66** in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is neutral but declining.
